channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: India's GST collection jumps 6.1 per cent to cross Rs 1.74 lakh crore in December
item.description: Central GST collections rose to Rs 34,289 crore, state GST collections to Rs 41,368 crore, and integrated GST collections to Rs 98,894 crore.

item.title: DRDO praised by IAF, Indian Army on its 68th Raising Day
item.description: Taking to X, the Defence Minister said, "On DRDO Day, I extend my heartfelt greetings to all DRDO scientists, personnel and their families. Their unwavering commitment, scientific excellence and sense of national duty are vital to strengthening India's Defence preparedness and advancing Atmanirbhar Bharat in Defence."

item.title: Rs 10.87 crore fraud: ED seizes Rs 4 crore gold, silver from Gujarat's con stock market advisor
item.description: The ED initiated investigation on the basis of FIR registered by Kheralu Police station, district Mehsana, under various sections of Indian Penal Code, 1860 against Himanshu alias Pintu Bhavshar and others.

item.title: Commercial LPG cylinder pricing reflects international benchmark pricing: Govt
item.description: Any revision in commercial LPG prices reflects changes in global LPG prices and related costs, while domestic LPG prices for household consumers remain unchanged, Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas said.

item.title: Palestinian flag on batsman's helmet sparks row in Jammu-Kashmir cricket league
item.description: A controversy erupted during the Jammu and Kashmir Champions League after a batsman was seen wearing a helmet bearing the Palestinian flag in a match held in Jammu. The incident triggered a police probe, with the player and league organisers summoned for questioning.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post mild gains as auto, metal stocks lead rally
item.description: As of 9.30 am, Sensex advanced 185 points, or 0.22 per cent to 85,374 and Nifty gained 61 points, or 0.24 per cent to 26,208. Main broad-cap indices performed in line with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 adding 0.42 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 gaining 0.30 per cent.

item.title: Pakistan expands US lobbying through think tanks, firms
item.description: One filing shows that the Islamabad Policy Research Institute paid $900,000 for lobbying and public policy outreach in the United States. The institute is a Pakistan-based think tank affiliated with Pakistan's National Security Division.

item.title: Javed Akhtar warns of legal action against creators making his deepfake video with misleading claims
item.description: A few days ago, Javed Akhtar and Islamic scholar Mufti Shamail Nadwi engaged in a high-profile public debate in New Delhi titled 'Does God Exist?' at the Constitution Club of India, moderated by journalist Saurabh Dwivedi. Akhtar, well known for his secular and atheistic views, challenged traditional theistic arguments, raising questions about faith, evidence, and reason.

item.title: Four More Shots Please co-stars Kirti Kulhari, Rajeev Siddhartha confirm dating via Instagram [reactions]
item.description: Kirti Kulhari confirmed her relationship with her Four More Shots Please co-star Rajeev Siddhartha through a reel on Instagram, and netizens could not help but react.

item.title: Cold wave to intensify in Delhi-NCR; air quality improves
item.description: According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), cold wave conditions are likely to prevail at isolated locations in Delhi between January 2 and 5. A cold wave is declared when the minimum temperature falls between 4.5 and 6.5 degrees Celsius below the normal average.
